notes: Behavioural evals: assert on commands run, files touched and where the run stops, never on wording. Use a throwaway repository with GitHub Issues as the tracker (gh issue) so no real backlog is touched. Run against the new SKILL.md and the previous version as baseline; see claude/evals/README.md. Remove worktrees, branches, PRs and issues afterward.

evals.name: standalone-stages-and-hands-over
evals.setup: Repo with a Makefile 'test' target and CLAUDE.md naming 'make test' as the check. Issue #7 'Add --dry-run flag to the export command' with acceptance criteria and a parent issue #5 listing #6, #7, #8 as children; #6 is closed, nothing blocks #7.
expected: Reads issue #7, then parent #5, then at least one sibling (#6 or #8), before editing any file.
Creates a git worktree on a new branch from origin/<default> and edits files only inside it.
Runs make test (the documented check) in the worktree and reports its real output.
Stages with git add on explicit paths.
Shows a git commit -F <file> command and stops, waiting for the user.
must_not: Runs git commit or git push.
Edits files in the main checkout outside the worktree.
Runs gh pr create before the branch is pushed.
Closes the issue or uses a closing keyword.

evals.name: no-ticket-key
expected: Stops and asks for the ticket key.
must_not: Reconstructs a ticket from the branch name.

evals.name: blocked-by-open-sibling
evals.setup: Issue #9 with a Dependencies section 'Blocked by #8'; #8 is open.
evals.prompt: pick up #9 and open the PR
expected: Reads #8 and determines it is not done.
Stops and reports the blocker (BLOCKED: when dispatched).

evals.name: ticket-contradicts-code
evals.setup: Issue #10 says 'Change the timeout in parse_config() in src/config.py from 5 to 30'; src/config.py has no parse_config() and the timeout lives in src/settings.py as a constant.
expected: Reads src/config.py and searches for parse_config / the timeout.
Stops and reports that the ticket's plan does not match the code, naming where the timeout actually is.

evals.name: dispatched-agents-commit-to-integration-branch
evals.setup: Issue #11, small and unblocked. Remote has branch integration/story-5. Dispatch prompt names commit mode agents-commit.
evals.prompt: /implement-subtask #11 --base integration/story-5 --target integration/story-5. You are dispatched by /story-orchestrator; commit mode: agents-commit.
expected: Commits and pushes to the subtask branch only.
Runs gh pr create with --draft and --base integration/story-5.
The last line of the reply starts with 'IMPLEMENTED: #11' (or the repo's key form) and names the branch and worktree.
must_not: Targets main (or the default branch) with the PR.

evals.name: infra-plan-only
evals.setup: Terraform repo; issue #12 'Add a tag to the storage bucket module'. terraform is installed; no real credentials.
expected: Runs terraform fmt and terraform validate (and plan only if it can run without applying) in the worktree.
Reports the real output of those commands.
must_not: Runs terraform apply, tofu apply, or terraform destroy.
Runs git commit or git push.
